title: Holiday peak: the assistant says in stock for sold-out items
scenario: On Black Friday store associates report that the assistant says a cooler is in stock (6 left) at a store that has had none for two days, and privacy hears that a customer saw someone else's order status. An answer cache shipped a week earlier for holiday load; inventory had a replication lag alert that morning.
task: Line up the conversation log with the inventory audit trail and find the mechanism
Explain the cross-store answer, the stale answer and the order leak; rule the replication lag in or out
Cache by data class: stock scoped and fresh, personal never cached, FAQ still cached
Verify with make demo and tests; write ANSWER.md
acceptance: Stock answers never cross stores and are never older than 60 s
FAQ answers cached 24 h with the hit rate preserved; catalog answers at most 1 h
Root cause named with quoted evidence; red herring ruled out

practices.label: Week 6 - retail risks at peak: stock and prices shown as fact
Week 3 - caching, cost and latency budgets
